q: Tenant shall pay a damage deposit of $500
No pets allowed in the unit
Landlord may increase the rent at any time during the lease
A $400 non-refundable administration fee is due at signing
If Tenant breaks the lease all remaining rent becomes due immediately
Tenant must pay for all repairs including the furnace
Landlord may enter the unit at any time without notice
Tenant may not sublet or assign the lease
Landlord may change the locks if rent is late
Tenant must move out at the end of the one-year term
Landlord can shut off heat or water if tenant does not pay
Tenant must provide post-dated cheques for the year
Last month's rent deposit does not earn interest
Lease is void if tenant has guests
